values: Use this to add a new article, or to correct one already loaded.
One row per material, per size range, per production stage. Required — without it an article cannot be planned.
One row per BOM size range or individual size: how many pairs fit in its carton.
One row per article and size range: MRP, description and machine. Repeat the exact Article Code for every range.
THE THREE THINGS PEOPLE GET WRONG
Rate per Pair is for ONE PAIR. Not per carton, not per dozen, not per hundred.
Repeat Article Code, Sole Type and Size Range on EVERY row. Never leave a cell blank to mean “same as above” — each row is read on its own.
Use one spelling per material. MESH 58" and Mesh-58" would be bought as two different materials, splitting the requirement between them.
EVA, PVC, PU, STUCK-ON   (dropdown on the BOM tab)
CUTTING, PREPARATION, STITCHING, UPPER_QC, MOLDING, ASSEMBLY, PACKING   (dropdown)
ROTARY or VERTICAL. Only for PVC articles — leave blank for any other sole.
In Factory OS, open Data & BOM and choose this file.
You see exactly what will change before anything is saved.
Nothing at all is saved, and you get the row number to fix.
Its BOM is REPLACED in full, and you must tick a box to confirm.
The previous version is kept. Roll it back from the same screen, under “Recent reference changes”.
